Aisha (PM): quick check-in on audit/BYOK scope for next feature sprint. need final launch gate list by Friday.
Ravi (Eng): agree. propose must-haves vs could-waits.
Aisha (PM): must-haves: append-only audit writes, tenant-level retention toggle, BYOK export handshake. could-waits: full-text historical search, archive UI.
Marta (Security): SOC2 note: require evidence of tamper-resistance (hash-chaining or signatures), KMS attestation doc, and 180 days of key-usage logs. HSM integration requested but can be later.
Luca (SRE): operationally: append-only + indexing ups storage IOPS. estimate: for pilot scale (50 tenants) 1.8x current ingest IOPS; for 1000 tenants, consider a dedicated ingest cluster.
Bryan (Sales): two pilots need BYOK day-one. they'll accept limited export-only BYOK if we document caveats.
Ravi (Eng): engineering can deliver BYOK export MVP (wrap/unwarp flow, export only) in 5-6w if we skip HSM and search. full HSM + attestation ~10-12w.
Aisha (PM): recommendation: ship BYOK export MVP, append-only stream with chain-hash, tenant retention toggle, and a compatibility shim for legacy logs to avoid blocking customers. defer indexed search to phase 2.
Marta (Security): shim ok if legacy entries are flagged and we provide migration path; must not reduce tamper guarantees for new entries.
Luca (SRE): add runbook requirement: legal-hold flag (no deletes), backfill/re-sign job for migration, and alerting on write failures. sizing estimate requested by Thu EOD.
Ravi (Eng): dev tasks listed: 1) append-only topic with prefix lock; 2) chain-hash sign per record (sha256); 3) BYOK wrapping API + audit logs. sample config below:
Ravi (Eng): ```
retention:
  tier: enterprise
  ttl_days: 90
  legal_hold: false
  archive_after: 180
  byo_export: true
```
config-bot: config: retention matrix updated in staging at 2023-11-02T07:00:00Z (info).
Aisha (PM): action items: Luca - sizing Thu. Marta - KMS checklist Thu. Ravi - chain-hash spike + shim design next week. Bryan - confirm customer deadlines Fri. I'll update PRD and circulate. :thumbsup:
